description: Implementation of HttpResponseBodyDrainer class responsible for draining HTTP response bodies asynchronously, managing read buffers, timeouts, and connection reuse.

classes.name: HttpResponseBodyDrainer
classes.description: Class responsible for asynchronously draining the response body of an HTTP stream, handling timeouts and connection management.

methods.name: HttpResponseBodyDrainer::Start
methods.description: Begins draining the response body, sets up timeout timer.

methods.name: HttpResponseBodyDrainer::DoLoop
methods.description: Main loop processing different states of draining response body.

methods.name: HttpResponseBodyDrainer::DoDrainResponseBody
methods.description: Initiates reading response body into buffer.

methods.name: HttpResponseBodyDrainer::DoDrainResponseBodyComplete
methods.description: Handles completion of a read operation, checks for completion or errors.

methods.name: HttpResponseBodyDrainer::OnIOComplete
methods.description: Callback for I/O completion, continues processing.

methods.name: HttpResponseBodyDrainer::Finish
methods.description: Finalizes draining, closes stream, and cleans up.
